description: 16 decidable submission cases over the Meridian Review handling rules, every one of which requires two or more rules to COMBINE. Built to the specification in theory/open-problems.md#15: MERIDIAN-34 is answered correctly from any competent 230-word brief by both local models, and the only probes that survived that saturation were its nine interaction-tagged ones. This measure is that class and nothing else.
